title: Thana Sareeramandhu – AR Stevenson Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: తన శరీరమందు మన పాపములు మోసెను క్రీస్తు
english: Thana sareeramandhu mana paapamulu mosenu Kreesthu
translation: Christ carried our sins in His own body.
Even though He committed no sin, He suffered for us.
The punishment was ours to bear—
How could such punishment be deserved by the innocent?
Even when He was insulted and accused,
He did not reply with harsh words.
By following in the footsteps of Jesus,
It is good for us to endure suffering.
Even when they tried to kill Him cruelly,
He did not hold any hatred.
Healing has been granted to us.
Even when unjust judgment was given against Him,
He did not argue in return.
intro: Thana Sareeramandhu (తన శరీరమందు) is the latest Telugu Christian song written, tuned, sung & music composed by Dr. A.R.Stevenson. This song was released on March 06, 2026, through SYMPHONY MUSIC YouTube Channel.
